one_line.text: A marketer and media-company operator who co-authored The Let Them Theory with her mother, Mel Robbins.

biography.text: Sawyer Robbins is Mel Robbins's oldest daughter. She studied at Boston College, worked in marketing, and joined 143 Studios, the family media company. Her public work around The Let Them Theory includes co-writing the book and discussing its application to family relationships and breakups on The Mel Robbins Podcast.

background.text: Her publicly documented background is in marketing, content, events, and media operations rather than clinical psychology or academic research. Her LinkedIn profile records Boston College and marketing work before 143 Studios.

expertise.text: She brings lived experience of the mother-daughter relationship used in the book and professional experience in marketing and content production. Public sources do not establish a clinical or research qualification.

perspective_and_limits.text: Her contribution is best understood as co-authorship, editorial and media experience, and a younger family perspective. The available biography is sparse and partly self-reported, so claims beyond those roles would be speculative.
